name: Site at Sample Site, Atlanta, GA
notes: Plan origin (0, 0) = the southwest corner of the site square. x = east, y = north (true north). All lengths are in feet.
Elevation: every z in this model is the true NAVD88 elevation minus 1010.00 ft. The lowest ground point is 0 ft. Add 1010.00 ft to return to NAVD88 elevations.
Origin at 33.918813, -84.336324 (latitude, longitude). Site size 500 ft by 500 ft. Ground grid 51 by 51 points, spacing 10 ft.
Roads, streams, centerlines and the site boundary are draped on the ground triangles. The Road centerlines tag is hidden.
This model is for conceptual design only. Ground is within about 3 ft, building height within 1 floor, building position within 10 ft.
